title: DAGWELL graph definition (event schema_version 1)
description: Shape of one executable graph definition document. This schema is a SHAPE AID for editors and external tooling, never a second source of truth: dagwell.graph.validate_graph is authoritative, and it enforces the rules a JSON Schema cannot express - unique node ids, dependencies that exist, acyclicity, and the R1 consecutive-same-family rule that requires r1_exception. A document accepted here may still be refused there; nothing accepted there is refused here.

graph_id.description: Stable name of the graph (today also the operation, contract 2).

deps.description: Node ids this node depends on; absent means no dependency.

output_evidence.description: Declared output evidence type (I28). Omission is a hard error before real execution.

no_verification.description: Signed vacuum: the explicit reason a node declares no obligatory verification (I5).

family.description: Closed IN FORM (contract 6). The model:<family> namespace itself is open (13.15) and is not registered here.

r1_exception.description: Written reason for two consecutive verifications of the same family (I16). Enforced by the validator, not expressible here.
